title: What would be your workflow for making a city?
author: Advanced_Invite9435
selftext:
I have been involved with 3d/cg since 2013, mostly Blender. Entire goal was to find likeminded people to produce a game prototype. Yet no matter who I dm'd on fartstation/polycrap I couldn't make a team.

  
I have been using CC since late September. 

  
I used Gemini pro for 3 months early this year but at the time its api abilities with Godot and blender seemed limited.

  
Overall in blown away with CC, it took my huge folder of unfinished and finished work and make all sorts of python kits from them.

The game prototype I'm working on has an openworld city vibe to it.

  
A few questions.

  
Best workflow for building up a cityscape?

  
(I've already made a load Grunderzeit style buildings and commie block style apartments, with CC making variations to them as well as street furniture​)***​***

  
I made some time ago a detailed subway map, which CC made schematics out of, but scaling it up into a proper city, loads of streets etc,CC kinda fails a bit, previously i had CC map out other trainlines, waterways and highways, but it always produces stuff which looked incorrect, even if i choose one district and ask it to do a street layout etc.

  
Does anyone have a better suggestion?

  
Would paying extra for Fable help? Or using sub agents? I tried startijg with villages and topography in the year 1000 and asking Opus to evolve the settlements forward in time but it didnt seem to work well.​

  
I'm open to using other LLMs too.
